metric_policy.null_means: not computed or not applicable; inspect metric_details.status
metric_policy.unanswerable: score reference similarity and abstention; mark key-fact/retrieval/citation evidence metrics N/A when no label
metric_policy.reference_multi_answer: maximum over validated equivalent references; log chosen reference
metric_policy.retrieval_ground_truth: ID-based relevance may omit valid alternative chunks; audit or semantic match
metric_policy.metric_score_range: typically [0,1], but raw BERTScore/cosine may be negative; latency/tokens/error rates differ
metric_policy.sacrebleu: aggregate on corpus, do not average sentence BLEU as corpus BLEU
